chooseResponse.q: Did you finish your history project?

conversation.transcript:
Student: Hey, have you talked to Professor Smith about the group project?
Advisor: Not yet, but I plan to do it this week.
Student: I think we should ask her for some guidance.
Advisor: That's a good idea! It will help us stay on track.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation?
questions.explain: 對話的主要主題是關於一個小組專案。
學生建議與教授見面以獲得指導。

talk.transcript: Today, I will discuss the concept of 'sustainability.' Sustainability refers to the ability to meet our present needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet theirs. It encompasses various dimensions, including environmental, social, and economic aspects. For instance, sustainable practices in agriculture can help preserve natural resources while ensuring food security. Additionally, sustainability encourages us to consider the long-term impacts of our actions. By adopting sustainable habits, we can contribute to a healthier planet and a more equitable society.

questions.explain: 可持續性是指滿足當前需求而不妨礙未來需求。

questions.q: Which area is NOT mentioned as part of sustainability?
questions.explain: 講座中沒有提到技術領域。

questions.explain: 講座中提到的可持續實踐之一是可持續農業。

questions.q: What is the ultimate goal of sustainability?
questions.explain: 可持續性的最終目標是確保長期影響。
